performance.verdict: Paid ads dead; GBP collapsing; 3 overdue milestones break the prove-it scoreboard.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still open — 57 GBP calls in 28 days cannot be tied to any lead record without it.
Sync + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) still open — 243 GHL contacts present but 0 appointments logged and 0 opps won, breaking the lead-to-chair scoreboard.
Renewal milestone (2026-07-23) not confirmed complete — prove-it month is live but account-level confirmation is missing from the record.
GBP actions crashed 76.81% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 28–30) show 8, 0, 0 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not seasonal noise.
Search clicks fell 28.57% week-over-week and GA4 sessions dropped 37%; last 3 days average 5 sessions vs prior 3-day average of ~9 — organic visibility eroding in parallel with GBP.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap immediately; 57 unattributed GBP calls make the prove-it scoreboard unreadable.
suggestions.monday_update: The attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) is confirmed open while GBP has logged 57 calls and 92 direction requests in 28 days — none traceable to a lead record. Close the phone-match gap so every inbound call from GBP is matched to a GHL contact and a pipeline opportunity. Success check: zero unmatched GBP calls in the next weekly sync audit. Must be resolved by 2026-09-03 — any later and August's prove-it scoreboard cannot be closed.

suggestions.text: Complete sync + contact cleanup; 0 appointments in GHL against 243 contacts signals an intake leak, not an ads failure.
suggestions.monday_update: The sync and contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) is still open; GHL shows 243 contacts, 96 opportunities created, 0 appointments, and 0 won — the pipeline is broken at the intake stage, not the ads stage. Complete the sync repair and patient-vs-lead tagging so appointments begin populating against the existing contact base. Success check: at least 1 verified appointment record visible in GHL by 2026-09-07, confirming the sync path is live end-to-end.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP daily actions for 3 more days; if Aug 31–Sep 2 stay at or near 0, escalate to GBP profile audit.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 28, 29, and 30 — a confirmed 3-day collapse from a 28-day total of 196 actions. Search clicks are also down 28.57% and sessions down 37%, suggesting a visibility problem rather than demand seasonality. Do not act on paid channels yet — paid spend is $0 and no campaign is live to shift. Re-check GBP actions on 2026-09-03; if the three-day average remains below 2 actions/day, escalate to a full GBP profile audit (suspensions check, category review, photo/post freshness).
